title: The Midnight Garden
author: Evelyn Hart
synopsis: A young girl discovers a hidden garden where forgotten memories come alive. As she explores its mysteries, she uncovers a secret about her family.

title: Whispers of the Sea
author: Clara Bennett
synopsis: After discovering an old journal along the coast, a young journalist begins investigating a decades-old disappearance in a quiet seaside town.

title: Beyond the Stars
author: Daniel Brooks
synopsis: A crew of astronauts discovers an abandoned spacecraft beyond the solar system and must uncover its secrets before returning home.

title: The Dragon's Promise
author: Amelia Rivers
synopsis: A young apprentice discovers a dragon egg hidden beneath an ancient castle and must protect it from a kingdom determined to destroy dragons.

title: Secrets of Willow Creek
author: James Carter
synopsis: When strange letters begin appearing throughout Willow Creek, three friends work together to uncover the mystery behind their small town.

title: The Last Autumn
author: Olivia Hayes
synopsis: Two childhood friends reunite in their hometown and discover that some feelings never disappear, even after years apart.
